neighbours.label: a short list of mid-word pieces in particular words: 'zek' in Hezekiah, 'Contents' in setContentsMargins, 'by' in Sotheby, 'bi' in Eusebius (not the same pieces after other prefixes)
fire: In the days of King Hezekiah the city wall was repaired.
The prophet Isaiah brought a message to Hezekiah.
A seal bearing the name of Hezekiah was found in the dig.
The necklace was auctioned at Sotheby's in Geneva.
An expert from Sotheby's valued the old clock.
The church history written by Eusebius survives in full.
quiet: In the days of King Josiah the city wall was repaired.
The prophet Ezekiel brought a message to the exiles.
A seal bearing the name of Ashby was found in the dig.
The necklace was auctioned at Christie's in Geneva.
An expert from Danby valued the old clock.
The church history written by Josephus survives in full.

notes: A list, not a pattern: probes fired on He|zek|iah, set|Contents, Sothe|by, Euse|bi and Get|Num (0.8-0.96 of max) but not on get|Contents, set|Num|Rows, Ash|by/Dan|by or Ezek|iel (<0.11), so the piece alone is not enough. I found no shared pattern behind the list.
